cycles.explanation: Ohio State, Indiana, Georgia, Alabama, Texas, Ole Miss, Kentucky, LSU, Tennessee, Missouri, Florida, Oklahoma, Auburn, Mississippi State, Iowa, South Carolina and Michigan form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 33 of them. The weakest link was Auburn's 27-24 win over Georgia (+5.5 adjusted margin; the winner rates 15.1 points worse on the power ratings; the loser fared better against 1 shared opponent. Since then: Auburn has more losses, 3 to 1; so the resume order decides how far apart they sit), so it was set aside, along with 9 other results in this loop.

BYU, Texas Tech, Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State, UCF and Cincinnati form a loop: following every head-to-head result among them leads back to where it started, so no ordering can honour all 8 of them. The weakest link was Cincinnati's 37-24 win over Texas Tech (+10.5 adjusted margin; the winner rates 13.8 points worse on the power ratings. Since then: Cincinnati has more losses, 2 to 1; so the resume order decides how far apart they sit), so it was set aside, along with 1 other result in this loop.

source.attribution: Data: CollegeFootballData.com -- betting lines, play-by-play PPA, and Strength of Record, Strength of Schedule and FPI via ESPN

stages: Stage 1 - rank every team by what it has achieved and how good it is: 0.55 x Strength of Record + 0.25 x market neutral-field rank + 0.2 x opponent-adjusted points added per play (all national ranks, lower is better).
Stage 2 - adjust for how your losses actually look: the venue and margin of each defeat, the quality of your best win, and how comfortably you win.
Stage 3 - when a result spans more than 15 places, pull both teams 0.35 of the way to their midpoint; the upset says both were mis-rated.
Stage 4 - reorder so as few head-to-head results as possible are contradicted, weighing each result by how convincing it was against how far a team would have to move.
Stage 5 - report every contradiction loop and every overridden result, so nothing is hidden.
methodology.summary: base = 0.55 x SoR + 0.25 x Mkt + 0.2 x PPA; pool 40; H2H strength 4, drift exponent 1.5; upset regression on (gap 15, 0.35)
